
Topic: Hydrodynamic Stability

Hydrodynamic stability studies whether small disturbances in fluid flow grow or decay.

The Rayleigh number measures the strength of buoyancy-driven thermal convection relative to dissipative effects.

The critical Rayleigh number is the threshold at which instability begins.

Linear stability analysis investigates the behavior of infinitesimally small disturbances.

Nonlinear stability analysis considers finite-amplitude disturbances and nonlinear effects.
